observation: At thumbnail scale the room still does not read as a room. Fire reads as a small articulated warm passage; cushion reads as a chromatic mound; threshold reads as a dark vertical interruption; upper wall bands remain procedural. The checkpoint metrics support the visual diagnosis without serving as aesthetic authority.
change: establish threshold as actual spatial recession
doNot: turn threshold into a glowing portal
nextPainterlyIntention: Create one believable spatial hinge at the threshold/floor/wall junction using selective value separation and lost/found edges, so the Hearth begins to exist as a place before its objects are further described.

experiment.successQuestion: Can a few perception-led touches materially improve the whole-composition read by creating spatial orientation without changing scene facts or object rendering?
